$comment: Plan Match Supplement gate config (~/Code/plan-match-supplement). Ported from the consumer widget's gate (~/Code/plan-match). The gate refuses to pass while any TODO placeholder remains. Commands run from the repo root. Package manager here is npm, not pnpm.
$comment_pushChecks: scripts/check-medsup-view.sh already existed in this repo and nothing ran it. Migration 005 revoked anon SELECT on pm_medsup_rate / pm_medsup_carrier / pm_supp_carrier_rates and created the _public views that filter pm_medsup_carrier_exclusions (Physicians Select, MedMutual Protect, Physicians Life). A read against a base table means a suppressed carrier can reach a consumer screen, or a 401 on an anon path. The gate now runs that check on every push.
$comment_typecheck: `npm run typecheck` runs typecheck:app (root tsconfig, include=[src]), typecheck:api (api/tsconfig.json, module=NodeNext) and typecheck:qa (the compliance harness). All three matter. Before api/tsconfig.json existed, everything under api/ shipped with no typecheck at all; qa/ is in the list because a compliance suite that no longer compiles is a compliance suite that is not running.
$comment_brainPaths: Files whose changes require a fresh full audit before shipping: the fit-score engine, rate lookup and carrier grouping, licensed-state gating, CMS premium constants, MBI validation, the Section 1557 language block, and the submission surface. Inert while fullAudit.enabled is false — this is the list the harness will consume when it lands.

fullAudit.$comment: The Medigap compliance sweep. Unlike the MA consumer harness this one builds HEAD and serves it locally (qa/playwright.config.ts webServer) and stubs every API call, so it tests the commit being pushed and needs no network and no production data. Four personas: OEP NC, underwritten NC, underwritten TX, and an unlicensed NY ZIP. Set QA_BASE_URL to aim it at a deployed environment instead.
fullAudit.$comment_known_red: AS OF 2026-09-18 THIS IS RED, deliberately. underwritten-tx fails on /rates: with no TX rows in pm_medsup_rate_public the rate widget never renders, so its 'not a quote or a guarantee of coverage' disclosure disappears — while the hardcoded paragraph in src/components/RateProjection.tsx still shows '$115-$180/month ... in your state' with an NC carrier list to a Texas applicant. Rob's call 2026-09-18: leave it red rather than exempt it. Brain-path pushes are blocked until the disclosure renders independently of the widget. Do not add an exemption to make this green.

$comment_protectedPaths: Edits here trigger an approval prompt for Rob. Three classes: (1) gate and validator files, so a failing check can't be 'fixed' by loosening it — qa/ is in this class, the whole compliance harness; (2) the medsup-view check, which is the only thing standing between a suppressed carrier and a consumer screen; (3) the regulated disclosure surface — the CMS/Medicare.gov language, Section 1557 taglines and nondiscrimination notice, the Medigap GI-rights and rate-type disclosures, and the carrier-authorization + TCPA consent block. Those are regulated text, not copy.
